description.subject: Young slim woman with long dark straight hair falling loose over her shoulders and back, slightly tousled with strands across the shoulder, natural minimal makeup, full lips, calm and serious expression, chin slightly lowered, looking directly at the camera
description.pose: Standing with her body angled slightly to the right of frame and hips pushed forward, both arms bent behind her back so the hands rest at the back of the waist, one shoulder bare, torso elongated, legs apart in a wide confident stance

clothing.top: Oversized light button-up shirt in a crisp cotton fabric, worn open and slipped off the right shoulder, the front bunched and gathered up above the waist so the midriff and navel are exposed, sleeves pushed and crumpled
clothing.bottom: Light-wash low-rise baggy straight-leg denim jeans with a wide waistband, silver button, front pockets and visible fading and whisker creases

description.setting: Plain light studio wall, seamless and empty, with a soft cast shadow of the subject falling on the wall to her left side
description.lighting: Strong directional light from the left side of the frame, bright highlights on the shirt and skin, soft gradient falloff to the right, clear shadow on the wall behind her, moderate contrast
description.composition: Vertical shot framed from the top of the head to the lower legs, subject slightly left of center, camera at a slightly low angle looking up, plenty of negative space on the right, thin light border around the image
description.style: Black-and-white editorial fashion photography, film-like look with visible grain, minimalist studio aesthetic
description.colors: Monochrome grayscale: bright whites on the shirt and wall, mid-gray denim, dark near-black hair, soft gray shadows
